title: Paired monic equations over a restricted valuation ring force order zero
statement: Let K, E, and L be fields with K-algebra structures on E and L, an E-algebra structure on L, and a compatible scalar tower K → E → L. Assume L is integral over E. Let w be a project place of L over K, let f ∈ L be nonzero, and let P,Q ∈ E[X] be monic. Suppose eval₂(algebraMap E L, f, P) = 0 and eval₂(algebraMap E L, f⁻¹, Q) = 0. If every coefficient of P and every coefficient of Q belongs to the valuation subring of w.restrict E, then w.ord f = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (K E L : Type*) [Field K] [Field E] [Field L] [Algebra K E] [Algebra K L] [Algebra E L] [IsScalarTower K E L] [Algebra.IsIntegral E L] (w : AlgebraicCurve.Place K L) (f : L) (P Q : Polynomial E), f ≠ 0 → P.Monic → Q.Monic → Polynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap E L) f P = 0 → Polynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap E L) (f⁻¹) Q = 0 → (∀ i : ℕ, P.coeff i ∈ (w.restrict E).toValuationSubring) → (∀ i : ℕ, Q.coeff i ∈ (w.restrict E).toValuationSubring) → w.ord f = 0
